citation: Inneholder data under norsk lisens for offentlige data (NLOD) tilgjengeliggjort av Brønnøysundregistrene.
bounding: Every unit in the Norwegian Enhetsregisteret with a registered business address in Norway, from the complete register snapshot of 2026-11-20. 1,181,715 units in the register; 29,908 have no registered business address and 44,846 have one outside Norway, so 1,106,961 are counted. Complete within that boundary; no filter on size, age, sector or notability. Same-day founding batches use stiftelsesdato (the founding date), recorded for 632,591 of those counted; units without one contribute to an address total but to no day, so a batch share is understated rather than inflated. The register-entry date is deliberately NOT used: it records migration into Enhetsregisteret, not founding. 43 address(es) whose line names a person rather than a place are withheld entirely, because a claim keyed on such a line is a claim about a private individual; the filter deliberately over-excludes, so some organisations without a legal-form suffix are withheld too. A further 1,050 units carry a founding date equal to one of the register's own bulk-load days (1995-02-19, 1995-02-20) and are treated as having none, because that value was backfilled from the migration rather than observed.
